Rent is annual (AED p.a.). The "Pmt Freq" column holds the number of cheques as text, e.g. "4 Cheques". The A/C column (N) is chiller info and reads "Chiller free" on every row. Area is in sq ft: a studio is about 455-469 and a 1BR about 742-816. The status "HOLDOVER-RENEWAL" is mapped to under_renewal because its lease end dates, in mid-November 2026, are after the run date. The as-of date is inferred from the file name because A1 is cut off.

discrepancies.title: OM 'net' yield 6.8% vs buyer's net 4.8%
discrepancies.why: The OM calls the yield net, but the 'net' yield equals the gross yield on asking price (6.9%); and it deducts AED 150,000 of costs from AED 11,360,000, against AED 2,814,666 of Year-1 operating costs a buyer bears. The screen uses Year-1 NOI after the mandate's vacancy, collection loss, management fee, full opex and input VAT.

impact.basis: engine Year-1 NOI minus the net income the OM yield implies

discrepancies.analyst_action: Ask the broker for the costs behind the net yield; rebuild NOI from the operating statement and service-charge budget.

discrepancies.title: Operating statement omits district cooling
discrepancies.why: The building is chiller-free, so the landlord pays district cooling, yet the statement has no cooling line. A whole-building owner bears these costs; the screen fills each from the mandate default per sq ft of NSA (the management fee is always the mandate's % of EGI). From the statement's NOI of AED 9,805,962 to the screen's Year-1 NOI of AED 8,320,239: income: rent-roll leases modelled lease by lease, net of re-letting downtime, vs statement income less AED 324,683; structural vacancy top-up and collection loss (house view), vs statement losses less AED 150,516; management fee at the mandate rate on EGI, vs the stated fee less AED 97,781; district cooling: absent from the statement, mandate default less AED 797,139; leasing fees on modelled turnover less AED 85,329; irrecoverable input VAT on costs less AED 30,274.

impact.basis: statement NOI minus the screen's Year-1 NOI; every component is in `bridge`

discrepancies.analyst_action: Request the missing bills (Empower/chiller, insurance schedule, reserve study, management agreement).

discrepancies.title: OM yield 6.8% is on asking price, before 6.2% acquisition costs

sources.label: acquisition costs (DLD 4%, broker, trustee, mortgage registration)

discrepancies.why: A buyer pays AED 10,176,618 on top of the price. On price plus costs the same income gives 4.8%.

impact.basis: OM income on price plus acquisition costs, minus the stated yield

discrepancies.analyst_action: Compare deals on yield on total cost; ask the broker to restate the yield on that basis.

discrepancies.title: 27.3% of in-place rent is from units let more than 10.0% above the screen reference

sources.label: 25 let units more than 10.0% above the screen reference rent
screen reference rent (a proxy, not the RERA index)

discrepancies.why: In a falling 2026 market these leases are expected to reset towards the screen reference at renewal or expiry, which takes about AED 367,600 a year off income as they roll; the engine models each reset at its expiry date. The mandate limit is 20.0% of income. The reference is a proxy: confirm the rents with the DLD Smart Rental Index calculator.

impact.basis: rent above the screen reference on over-rented leases, lost as each renews or expires

discrepancies.analyst_action: Check the over-rented leases' expiry dates and tenants; price the resets into the offer.

notices.text: Tenants' security deposits of AED 595,850 transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
Cheque profile: 45% of rent on 1-2 cheques, 37% of rent on 3-4 cheques, 18% of rent on 6 or more cheques. More cheques mean more collection risk and less post-dated cheque cover.
Statement NOI moved +8.3% against the prior period (Prior year).

diligence_checklist.text: Title deed and DLD ownership search: freehold status, single title, and that the buyer is eligible to own the plot.
Building completion certificate (Dubai Municipality) for the as-built building.
Affection plan and permitted use: confirm residential use and the plot's permitted floors match the building.
Ejari export for every lease, reconciled to the rent roll unit by unit.
Civil Defence completion and annual fire-safety certificates, and ACP cladding compliance.
Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences and VAT treatment of shop rents.

memo.markdown:
## Verdict
**Needs work**: the building passes every hard mandate filter but fails the yield, return and over-renting tests, and only clears the return target at a price far below asking.

Buy at AED 85.7m [[uw.walk_away_price_aed]], exit at 6.2% [[uw.exit_yield]]. That is 48% below asking [[uw.walk_away_vs_asking]], against an asking price of AED 164.5m [[deal.asking_price_aed]]. The assumption that most moves the walk-away price is the exit yield: a move of 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] either way shifts it by AED 9.4m [[uw.walk_away_largest_swing_aed]]. The walk-away price and returns rest on the firm's house view of rents, exit yield, vacancy and downtime, not on market evidence for this building.

## The deal
- **What and where:** Kestrel Tower, Business Bay (Marasi Drive side), 107 units [[om.unit_count]], completed 2019 [[deal.completion_year]], freehold single title.
- **Price:** asking AED 164.5m [[deal.asking_price_aed]], which is AED 1,857 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_nsa]] on NSA.
- **Income:** in-place rent AED 11.4m [[rr.in_place_rent_aed]] at 93% [[rr.occupancy_by_units]] occupancy by units (rent roll at 31 October 2026 [[rr.as_of]]). Leases are direct with tenants, with no master tenant. The landlord pays the chiller.

## Returns
| Metric (unlevered, pre-tax) | Deal | Mandate |
|---|---|---|
| IRR | a loss of 0.1% a year [[uw.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]] | at least 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] |
| Equity multiple | 0.99x [[uw.unlevered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]] | at least 1.30x [[mandate.target_unlevered_equity_multiple.threshold]] |
| Going-in net yield on total cost | 4.8% [[uw.going_in_net_yield_on_cost]] | at least 6.0% [[mandate.min_going_in_net_yield_on_cost.threshold]] |
| Entry yield on price | 5.1% [[uw.entry_yield_on_price]] | none |
| Exit yield | 6.2% [[uw.exit_yield]] | none |

Year-1 NOI is AED 8.3m [[uw.noi_year1]].

Levered (secondary): a loss of 3.5% a year [[uw.levered_irr_pre_tax]] and a 0.84x [[uw.levered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]] multiple. Year-1 DSCR is 1.40x [[uw.dscr_year1]].

The OM headline yield is 6.8% [[om.yield_stated]], called net on asking price. On a buyer's basis (Year-1 NOI on price plus acquisition costs) it is 4.8% [[uw.om_yield.buyer_net_on_total_cost]]. The gap against the OM figure is negative: 2.0 points [[uw.om_yield.gap_vs_stated]] below what the OM states.

## What would make it fail
- **Exit yield and rents.** No sensitivity case gets near the target. The best case, with market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] higher and the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] tighter, gives an unlevered IRR of 2.6% [[uw.sens.r+5.e-50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. With market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower and the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider, it is a loss of 2.8% a year [[uw.sens.r-5.e+50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. The house view has market rents falling 3% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]] in Year 1.
- **Over-rented leases.** 27% [[uw.over_rent_share_of_income]] of in-place rent comes from units let well above the screen reference, against a 20% [[mandate.max_over_rent_share_of_income.threshold]] limit. Resets at expiry take AED 368k [[uw.over_rent_excess_at_expiry_aed]] a year off income.
- **Expiry bunching.** 26% [[uw.max_expiry_share_quarter]] of rent, AED 3.0m [[uw.max_expiry_window_rent_aed]], expires between 30 April 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_start]] and 30 July 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_end]]. That is inside the mandate limit, but it rolls into a falling market.
- **Overstated NOI.** The operating statement shows more income than a buyer will keep (see Discrepancies).

## Discrepancies
Items are most severe first. Lower-severity items, if any, are not discussed.

1. **OM "net" yield is really gross, and the statement omits district cooling (high).** The OM's 6.8% [[om.yield_stated]] "net" yield matches the gross yield on asking price and deducts only a small cost figure. The statement shows NOI of AED 9.8m [[bridge.statement_noi_aed]] but has no district cooling line, although the landlord pays it. The screen fills it with the mandate default of AED 797k [[bridge.step4]]. It also uses modelled income, a vacancy and collection top-up, a mandate-rate management fee, leasing fees and irrecoverable VAT. That brings Year-1 NOI to AED 8.3m [[bridge.screen_noi_year1_aed]]. Impact: statement NOI is overstated by AED 1.5m [[disc.missing_opex_items.impact_aed]]. The screen relied on mandate defaults for the missing cost.
2. **Yield before acquisition costs (medium).** The OM yield is on asking price, before acquisition costs of 6.2% [[uw.acquisition_costs_pct_of_price]] of price. This is part of the same headline yield gap shown above, so I have not counted it again.
3. **Units let above the screen reference (medium).** The resets are modelled at each lease's expiry. The impact is the AED 368k [[disc.over_rented_vs_market.impact_aed]] above. The reference is a proxy.

## Checks before diligence
- Ask the broker for the costs behind the "net" yield. Rebuild NOI from the operating statement and service-charge budget.
- Request the missing bills: Empower/chiller, insurance schedule, reserve study and management agreement.
- Ask the broker to restate the yield on total cost.
- Check expiry dates and tenants on the over-rented leases. Price the resets into the offer and confirm rents with the DLD Smart Rental Index calculator.
- Security deposits of AED 595,850 [[notice.security_deposits]] transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
- Cheque profile: 45% [[notice.cheque_profile]] of rent is on one or two cheques and 18% [[notice.cheque_profile]] is on six or more cheques. More cheques mean more collection risk.
- Statement NOI rose 8.3% [[notice.statement_trend]] against the prior year. Understand why.
- Title deed and DLD ownership search, including buyer eligibility.
- Building completion certificate.
- Affection plan and permitted use.
- Ejari export for every lease, reconciled to the rent roll.
- Civil Defence certificates and ACP cladding compliance.
- Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences and VAT treatment.

## Assumptions
The exit yield of 6.2% [[uw.exit_yield]] is the higher of the area yield and entry yield, plus 25 bps [[assume.exit_yield_expansion_bps]] of expansion and an age premium, over a 5-year [[uw.hold_years]] hold. Market rent falls 3% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]] in Year 1 and 1% [[assume.rent_growth_year2]] in Year 2, then grows 2% [[assume.rent_growth_year3]], 3% [[assume.rent_growth_year4]] and 3% [[assume.rent_growth_year5]]. Structural vacancy is 5.0% [[assume.structural_vacancy]] and collection loss is 1.0% [[assume.collection_loss]]. The loan is 33% [[uw.ltv]] of value, sized to a 1.40x [[assume.sizing_dscr]] DSCR, at 6.8% [[uw.interest_rate]] interest. District cooling, at AED 797k [[uw.opex_default.district_cooling]], is a mandate default because the package lacked it.
